request.style: English, worship, male solo with choir, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, soft drums, reverent and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Assembled at the river's bend
We camped for three days near the end
I reviewed the priests and people all
But found no Levites standing tall

[Pre-Chorus]
So I called the leaders forth
With urgent words upon their mouth
To Casiphia they must go
And find the servants we need so

[Chorus]
Bring us ministers for the house
Of our God who is the source
With gracious hand upon our side
They answered to the sacred guide

[Verse]
Sent to Iddo with clear command
To bring the servants of our land
The gracious hand of our God was there
And answered with abundant care

[Chorus]
Bring us ministers for the house
Of our God who is the source
With gracious hand upon our side
They answered to the sacred guide

[Verse]
Sherebiah came from Mahli's line
Eighteen men with him to shine
Hashabiah and Jeshaiah joined
Twenty men in faith combined

[Chorus]
Bring us ministers for the house
Of our God who is the source
With gracious hand upon our side
They answered to the sacred guide

[Outro]
Two hundred and twenty souls registered by name
Serving the house without shame
